body: Turn the subject in the reference photo into a small collectible keychain charm. Preserve recognizable colors and facial features in a simplified miniature form. Add a believable metal loop and short chain attached at the top. Photograph the charm beside a real key on a warm tabletop, using soft window light and shallow depth of field.
